scripts.check: node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check player-bridge.js && node --check player-bridge.test.cjs && node --check subtitle-sync.test.cjs && python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text()) for p in ('browser_smoke.py', 'interactive_test.py', 'test_real_youtube.py')]"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python browser_smoke.py --headless; else python3 browser_smoke.py --headless; fi
scripts.test:browser:headed: if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python browser_smoke.py; else python3 browser_smoke.py; fi
scripts.test:interactive: if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python interactive_test.py; else python3 interactive_test.py; fi
scripts.test:live: if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python test_real_youtube.py; else python3 test_real_youtube.py; fi
